Bettina, I haven't set up the Monday digest yet. The scheduler refused my request: the Gateway's automation service needs credentials that aren't configured for me, and I couldn't check whether a digest job already exists. I haven't posted anything either.

Once the scheduler is working, I'll set it up for Mondays at 08:00 Chicago time, starting Monday 19 October. Each digest will cover the past week's posts in #coastal-team and #coastal-random, plus open customer items. Both channels have the same four members, so nothing new reaches anyone. Money terms and finance documents will be left out, since those go only to Anselm, June, and the account owner. Operational items like ticket numbers, contacts, and meeting times will stay in.

Someone with Gateway admin access needs to restore the scheduler's credentials. Let me know when that's done and I'll create the job.
